> [!PREVIEW]
> `backdown entities` isn't in v0.2.0-alpha.4, the current download: it comes with the next preview.


```text
backdown entities [OPTIONS] [PATHS]...
```

## Arguments

`[PATHS]...`
: Only these drives (or the drives these paths are on).

## Options

`--refresh`
: Recognise again even if nothing was scanned since.

`--kind <KIND>`
: Only this kind (mail-store, timemachine, ios-backup, git, photos, …).

`--json`
: Print it as JSON, for scripts.

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

Kinds: `mail-store`, `maildir`, `mdbox`, `thunderbird`, `nextcloud`, `nextcloud-server`, `timemachine`, `ios-backup`, `android-backup`, `system`, `home-mac`, `home-linux`, `home-windows`, `website`, `git`, `sql-dump`, `disk-image`, `photos`, `music`, `videos`, `export`, `downloads`, `recovery`. Reading where things came from needs the drive connected: small files only (backup scripts, plists, git config, dump headers).

## Examples

```sh
backdown entities
backdown entities /media/old-drive --kind mail-store
backdown entities --refresh --json > entities.json
```
